errors.text: The proposed Ta-to-Ti substitution does not reconstruct the target intervention of adding 4.2 at.% Cr by vacuum arc melting.
No evidence establishes that the proposed substitution preserves strength, ductility, or creep resistance in this specific alloy at approximately 1000 °C.
Preservation of a high-entropy composition is asserted as the mechanical-retention mechanism without identifying a testable structural mediator.
The intervention amount and relevant loading boundaries are unspecified.
